definition: Each club Practice/Game-Status report listing every player with a reportable injury with participation level and game status
capture_rule: Capture Wed/Thu/Fri PDFs per week with ET timestamp team hash and license record; reject non-official feeds

definition: DNP / Limited / Full per day — defines reportable injury per policy
capture_rule: Retain per-player per-day status; DNP without injury label is still reportable

definition: Out / Doubtful / Questionable / — (active) — final availability designation
capture_rule: Store final Game Status (usually Friday) with timestamp before inactive deadline

definition: 90-minute pre-kick inactive list confirming who does not dress
capture_rule: Capture inactive list at 90-min deadline with hash; compare to earlier practice report

definition: 1st / 2nd / 3rd / 4th string per position group (QB RB WR TE OL DL LB DB K)
capture_rule: No official depth chart license exists; design requires licensed depth snapshot per game; values stay blank

definition: 1 − (available starter snaps / expected starter snaps) per unit (OL DL secondary QB skill)
capture_rule: Computed from depth + injury snapshots; blank until both feeds are licensed and timestamped

definition: Offense starter share: fraction of offensive snaps taken by Week-1 starters vs backups
capture_rule: Requires play-by-play with personnel tracking; blank until licensed

definition: Defense starter share: fraction of defensive snaps taken by Week-1 starters vs backups
capture_rule: Same as above for defensive units

definition: Flag when 2nd/3rd/4th-string player replaces a starter due to lineup/injury by position
capture_rule: Flag = 1 if depth before >1 and injury status is Out/Doubtful for starter; blank until feeds exist

definition: Injury report updates throughout the day; single static snapshot is insufficient
capture_rule: Store feature_asof forecast event_start with ET zone; require feature_asof ≤ forecast < event_start
